outcome: Anal incontinence (long term, mentioned as a potential consequence)
cohort: The study included 60,145 women who delivered in Hospital Parc Tauli between 1998 and 2021, excluding those without vaginal delivery or delivery before 22nd gestational week.
finding: OASIS were reported in 0.74% of all vaginal deliveries, predominantly in forceps deliveries, and showed a significant reduction from 2018 to 2021.
mod_finding: The study found a predominance of OASIS in forceps deliveries and a decline in OASIS incidence parallel to an increase in vacuum deliveries and a decrease in forceps use since 2018.
gest_age: Deliveries before 22nd gestational week were excluded.
